stages.name: genus5_quotient_structure
command:
import sys,json,asyncio; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); from fastmcp import Client; from rational_circle_mcp import mcp
async def go():
    async with Client(mcp) as c:
        r=await c.call_tool('genus5_quotient_structure',{}); d=r.data if r.data is not None else json.loads(r.content[0].text)
        ok=all(d['identities_verified'].values()) and all((q.get('infinite_order') or {}).get('torsion') is False for q in d['quotients'].values()) and all(q['lmfdb']['isomorphism_verified'] for q in d['quotients'].values())
        print('QUOTIENT_STRUCTURE', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
asyncio.run(go())
stages.certifies: quotient identities, Nagell-Lutz infinite-order witnesses, LMFDB isomorphisms
